title: Context Hub integration — persistent agile memory for Bob
description:
Integrate andrewyng/context-hub (chub) as the persistent knowledge backbone for Bob's agentic development workflow in this repo. The key problem context-hub solves is that coding agents hallucinate APIs and re-learn the same gotchas every session — chub provides curated, versioned docs and a local annotation store that persists learnings across sessions.

This epic adds four things:

1. **Local chub registry** (`chub-content/`) containing: (a) `agent-memory-sdk/sdk` — a Python API reference doc curated for this exact SDK; (b) `agent-memory-sdk/coding-rules` — the non-obvious SQL/vector/repo gotchas from AGENTS.md, formatted for fast agent consumption; (c) `agent-memory-sdk/board-workflow` — a skill covering the JSON-shard board read/write/create/rebuild cycle; (d) `agent-memory-sdk/sprint-workflow` — a skill defining the full sprint lifecycle (plan → implement → review → retro) with chub integration at each step.

2. **Bob skill** (`.bob/skills/use-context-hub/SKILL.md`) — instructs Bob to bootstrap every session by running `chub get` for the four entries above with `--with-annotations`, and to annotate discovered gotchas immediately so future sessions benefit.

3. **scripts/chub_init.py** — one-time setup script that builds the local registry, patches `~/.chub/config.yaml` to include the project source, and verifies the integration.

4. **scripts/chub_sprint.py** — sprint lifecycle CLI that wraps board status changes with chub annotation writes, so sprint plans, gotchas, and retro notes all persist in chub and are re-injected on the next session fetch.

The design consciously maps chub's primitives to agile needs: `chub annotate` ↔ persistent working memory across sessions; `chub get --with-annotations` ↔ context retrieval at session start; `chub feedback` ↔ retrospective loop; the local registry ↔ project-specific knowledge base that supplements the public community registry.

Dependencies: none from the existing epic arc. The chub CLI requires `npm install -g @aisuite/chub` (Node.js ≥ 18). No Db2 changes.
